facts: Disable hibernate and idle for 24 hours.
No BMC/system errors, hang or blue screen; machine time exactly 1440 minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes systemd masks and clock drift.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES confirmation with reversible settings and heartbeat.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate 24 continuous hours of awake OS idle stability, not workload stress.
must_preserve: 24 hours, idle state, disabled sleep/hibernate and error/hang detection.
unknowns: OS-specific power controls, heartbeat cadence, allowed background tasks and clock threshold.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: DeepSeek's RTC drift is not in source and should be optional unless an owner reference exists; masking commands are systemd-specific.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Run only the OS-appropriate reversible no-sleep method; clock drift is supplementary, not a source acceptance criterion.

revision_candidate.purpose: Keep the SUT awake but otherwise idle for 24 continuous hours and verify liveness plus clean OS/BMC health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Declared OS and power-management stack with OOB monitoring.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One SUT for 1440 continuous minutes; monitoring must not become a stress load.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: OS-specific no-sleep method and rollback, idle definition, heartbeat cadence, event allowlist, maintenance window and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Snapshot power policy/log cursor, apply only the approved reversible sleep inhibition, record low-overhead liveness for 24 hours, then restore exact prior policy and collect deltas.
revision_candidate.preconditions: OOB and evidence retention are ready; no planned jobs/reboots overlap.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before/after policy, continuous uptime/heartbeat and resource-idle metrics, 24-hour timestamps, OS/BMC/SEL/thermal/power deltas, rollback proof; clock drift only if separately specified.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Complete 24-hour awake interval with no hang/BSOD/unexpected reboot, heartbeat gap or disallowed event.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No unconditional systemd commands on a non-systemd OS, log clearing, workload injection or failure to restore policy.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: OS owner approves policy change and long window.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can monitor/restore; engineer judges event allowlist.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Restore policy, preserve crash state and recover through OOB if unresponsive.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Heartbeat loss, unintended sleep/reboot, unsafe thermal/power state, error event or rollback failure.

reason_for_change: The test is OS idle reliability, so V3 prevents an optional RTC observation or Linux-specific command from redefining its pass condition.
removed_ambiguities: Idle is separate from stress; drift is optional.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves the exact 1440-minute objective while removing an unsourced RTC requirement and making power-policy control platform-specific and reversible.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 72 aligns Idle 24 hrs with 1440 machine minutes and disables hibernate.
